scope: Explicit account-state item and resource keys for the current pilot's basic fishing, woodcutting, mining, farming, construction, quest, and utility actions. IDs are current RuneLite ItemID constants; broken, scenery-only, empty-dose, currency, and observation-only states are excluded.

sources.use: Primary canonical item identity and integer IDs.
Fishing tool and bait semantics, including rod, fly rod, feather, bait, net, lobster pot, and harpoon relationships.
Basic fishing method requirements and distinction between reusable tools and consumable bait.
Axe usability and Woodcutting capability semantics.
Pickaxe usability and Mining capability semantics.
Watering-can dose behavior; only positive-dose states are usable for watering.

mappings.notes: Presence aggregation is correct because this key represents any currently usable inventory/equipment axe for pilot actions. Charged infernal/crystal forms are included; uncharged forms and non-axe weapons are excluded.

Presence aggregation is correct because any usable pickaxe satisfies the generic Mining tool gate. Charged infernal/crystal forms are included; uncharged forms, broken pickaxes, handles, and heads are excluded.
Either usable hammer satisfies the current pilot's reusable hammer requirement; specialized hammers are included only where they remain usable as the same tool.
Presence aggregation treats the normal, crystal, and Amy's saw as interchangeable saw capability for current Construction actions. The inactive crystal saw is excluded.
Both are usable knife variants for the pilot's cutting/fletching utility; the fletching knife is not counted as a separate resource.
Either item provides the ordinary chisel capability; the jeweller's chisel is included because it also functions as a regular chisel.
Inventory item only; the similarly named small-fishing-net scenery object is not an item ID mapping.
Usable rod variants for bait-rod actions. Oily and pearl variants are included only as rod-equivalent inventory/equipment items; bait remains a separate consumable key.
Reusable fly-fishing tool; feathers are mapped separately as a consumable resource.
The model key is plural while RuneLite's item name is singular. Current progression actions use items.feathers; feathers are stackable and consumed by applicable lure-fishing attempts.
Stackable bait consumed by applicable bait-fishing attempts.
Usable harpoon variants for fishing actions. The infernal harpoon is included as the functional variant; charge state is not modeled as a separate quantity here.
Reusable lobster-pot fishing tool.
Reusable Farming tool; handle and head components are excluded.
Reusable planting tool.
Both are usable secateurs variants for Farming actions; magic secateurs are an upgrade, not a separate consumable.
Normal usable spade for the current pilot. Special decorative or location-specific spades are not assumed interchangeable with every spade gate.
Reusable fire-lighting tool.
Reusable grinding tool.

Dose variants are semantically valid because watering requires a positive dose. max aggregation expresses usable capacity without summing mutually exclusive dose states; empty watering can (5331) is excluded.
Empty buckets are stack-counted as item quantity. Filled buckets are different resource states and are not silently folded into this key.
Stack-counted reusable/consumable quest and traversal item; the model uses quantity where an action requires more than one.
